props.heading1: Built for real care businesses, not generic templates.
props.copy2: Practical decisions, clear scope, considered design and reliable information.
props.heading3: What makes a useful care website?
props.copy4: Choosing care is a significant decision. Families need genuine information about services, locations, facilities and what happens when they enquire. The website should answer those questions without making them hunt.
props.copy5: A residential care home needs to present the environment and daily life. A home care agency needs clear service areas and care types. We design differently for each.
props.copy7: We plan the structure, page journeys and copy, then design responsive layouts and build the website. Projects can be a new site or an improvement to something already online.
props.copy8: We consider mobile usability, accessible navigation, clear contact routes, practical loading performance and sensible on-page search foundations.
props.copy10: A typical project can include discovery, page planning, design, development, content refinement, testing and launch. The exact deliverables are agreed before work starts.
props.copy11: We avoid invented imagery or claims about your care provision. You approve service details, photography and any sensitive or regulated information.
props.copy13: First, we understand your service and what families need to know. Then we map the pages and agree the content. After design and development, we test navigation, forms and the experience on smaller screens.
props.copy14: The aim is a reliable, understandable website — not a showreel of unnecessary animations.
props.copy16: Once live, you can maintain the website yourself or ask us to handle agreed updates and improvements. If growing organic visibility is the next challenge, our SEO and local search support can help families discover the website.
props.copy17: Our guide on choosing a care website explains the practical decisions in greater detail.
props.copy18: Before briefing a build, use the care website checklist to review family information, accessibility and enquiry delivery. After launch, website management can support approved updates when teams, care services or contact arrangements change.
props.heading19: What does your care business need?
props.copy20: Tell us what you’re trying to improve. We’ll discuss the most useful next step.

props.heading3: Can you redesign an existing site?＋
props.copy4: Yes. We can review what to keep, what to improve and whether a partial redesign or complete rebuild makes sense.
props.heading5: Do I have to buy monthly support?＋
props.copy6: No. We discuss ownership, hosting and platform arrangements transparently before work begins.
props.copy8: The build includes sensible technical and content foundations. Ongoing search optimisation can be commissioned separately.
